title: The battle between Rama and Ravana
introduction: Ravana enters the battle-field and with his mystic missile, frightens several monkeys and destroys them. Rama and Lakshmana come and attack Ravana. Then, Rama and Ravana fight each other with various kinds of arrows. When the missile employed by Ravana is struck down by Rama, all the monkeys shout loudly with a rejoice.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकोनशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 99th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
महोदरमहापार्श्वौ हतौ दृष्ट्वा तु राक्षसौ |
तस्मिंश्च निहते वीरे विरूपाक्षे महाबले
आविवेश महान्क्रोधो रावणन् तु महामृधे |
सूतन् सञ्चोदयामास वाक्यन् चेदमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
mahodaramahApArśvau hatau dṛṣṭvA tu rAkṣasau |
tasmiṃśca nihate vIre virUpAkṣe mahAbale
Aviveśa mahAnkrodho rAvaṇan tu mahAmṛdhe |
sUtan sañcodayAmAsa vAkyan cedamuvAca ha
verses.translation: Seeing Mahodara and Mahaparshva the demons having been killed, and that valiant and mighty Virupaksha struck down in that great battle, a tremendous anger took possession of Ravana. He urged on his charioteer and addressed to him the following words:

verses.devanagari:
निहतानाममात्यानान् रुद्धस्य नगरस्य च |
दुःखमेषोअपनेष्यामि हत्वा तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ
verses.iast:
nihatAnAmamAtyAnAn ruddhasya nagarasya ca |
duḥkhameṣoapaneṣyAmi hatvA tau rAmalakṣmaṇau
verses.translation: "Killing those two princes, Rama and Lakshmana, I will remove surely the sorrow caused to me on account of the ministers who have been killed and the city which has been laid siege to (by the monkeys)."

glosses.meaning: on account of the ministers who have been killed
and the city which has been laid seize to (by the monkeys)

verses.devanagari:
रामवृक्षन् रणे हन्मि सीतापुष्पफलप्रदम् |
प्रशाखा यस्य सुग्रीवो जाम्बवान्कुमुदो नलः
स दिशो दश घोषेण रथस्यातिरथो महान् |
नादयन्प्रययौ तूर्णन् राघवन् चाभ्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
rAmavṛkṣan raṇe hanmi sItApuṣpaphalapradam |
praśAkhA yasya sugrIvo jAmbavAnkumudo nalaḥ
sa diśo daśa ghoṣeṇa rathasyAtiratho mahAn |
nAdayanprayayau tUrṇan rAghavan cAbhyavartata
verses.translation: "In the battle, I will cut down the tree in the shape of Rama, which is going to yield fruit through its flower in the form of Seetha, whose principal branches are Sugreeva, Jambavan, Kumuda, Nala, Dvivida, Mainda, Angada, Gandhamadana, Hanuma, Sushena and all the chiefs of monkey-warriors."

glosses.meaning: the tree in the shape of Rama
which is going to yield fruit through its flower in the form of Seetha
and all the chiefs of monkey-warriors.

verses.devanagari:
पूरिता तेन शब्देन सनदीगिरिकानना |
सञ्चचाल मही सर्वा सवराहमृगद्विपा
verses.iast:
pUritA tena śabdena sanadIgirikAnanA |
sañcacAla mahI sarvA savarAhamṛgadvipA
verses.translation: Ravana, the mighty and the surpassing Chariot-Warrior, went quickly, making a noise in all the ten directions, with the sound of the chariot, rushing towards Rama.

glosses.meaning: the mighty and the surpassing chariot-warrior

verses.devanagari:
तामसन् सुमहाघोरन् चकारास्त्रं सुदारुणम् |
निर्ददाह कपीन्सर्वान्स्ते प्रपेतुः समन्ततः
verses.iast:
tAmasan sumahAghoran cakArAstraṃ sudAruṇam |
nirdadAha kapInsarvAnste prapetuḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Filled with that sound, the entire earth, with its rivers, mountains and forests, trembled, throwing lions, antelopes and birds, into fright.

verses.devanagari:
तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः |
दृष्ट्वा भग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः
verses.iast:
tAnyanIkAnyanekAni rAvaṇasya śarottamaiḥ |
dṛṣṭvA bhagnAni śataśo rAghavaḥ paryavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: He employed very highly terrific and exceedingly frightful mystic missile called Tamasa, which began to consume all the monkeys, who started falling down on all sides.

verses.devanagari:
उत्पपात रजो भूमौ तैर्भग्नै संप्रधावितैः |
न हि तत्सहितुं शेकुर्ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं स्वयम्
verses.iast:
utpapāta rajo bhūmau tairbhagnai sampradhāvitaiḥ |
na hi tatsahituṃ śekurbrahmaṇā nirmitaṃ svayam
verses.translation: Dust began to fly up from the earth, while those frustrated monkeys were fleeing away for they could no longer bear that missile built by Brahma himself.

glosses.meaning: as they could no longer indeed

verses.devanagari:
तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः |
दृषःट्वा भग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः
verses.iast:
tānyanīkānyanekāni rāvaṇasya śarottamaiḥ |
dṛṣḥṭvā bhagnāni śataśo rāghavaḥ paryavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing those hundreds of many of his armies shattered by excellent arrows of Ravana, Rama took his stand, ready for the battle.

verses.devanagari:
ततो राक्षसशार्दूलो विद्राव्य हरिवाहिनीम् |
स ददर्श ततो रामन् तिष्ठन्तमपराजितम्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विष्णुना वासवन् यथा |
आलिखन्तमिवाकाशमवष्टभ्य महद्धनुः
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षन् दीर्घबाहुमरिन्दमम् |
verses.iast:
tato rākṣasaśārdūlo vidrāvya harivāhinīm |
sa dadarśa tato rAman tiṣṭhantamaparAjitam
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrAtrA viṣṇunA vAsavan yathA |
AlikhantamivAkAśamavaṣṭabhya mahaddhanuḥ
padmapatraviśAlAkṣan dIrghabAhumarindamam |
verses.translation: Having driven away the army of monkeys, Ravana the foremost among the demons then saw Rama, the annihilator of his enemies, who was endowed with long arms and eyes as wide as lotus petals standing unconquered with his brother Lakshmana-like Indra the lord of celestials is seen with Vishnu, the supreme lord of preservation-holding up his great bow as though scraping the sky.

glosses.meaning: as Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामो महातेजाः सौमित्रिसहितो बली
वानरांश्च रणे भग्नानापतन्तन् च रावणम् |
समीक्ष्य राघवो हृष्टो मध्ये जग्राह कार्मुकम्
verses.iast:
tato rāmo mahātejāḥ saumitrisahito balī
vAnarAṃśca raṇe bhagnAnApatantan ca rAvaṇam |
samIkṣya rAghavo hṛṣṭo madhye jagrAha kArmukam
verses.translation: Seeing the disappointed monkeys and Ravana advancing, the mighty Rama who was endowed with a great splendour and accompanied by Lakshmana who were born in Raghu dynasty, then pleasingly seized his bow at the middle.

glosses.meaning: who was born in Raghu dynasty
whow as advancing quickly towards him

verses.devanagari:
विस्फारयितुमारेभे ततः स धनुरुत्तमम् |
महावेगं महानादं निर्भिन्दन्निव मेदिनीम्
verses.iast:
visphArayitumArebhe tataḥ sa dhanuruttamam |
mahAvegaṃ mahAnAdaṃ nirbhindanniva medinIm
verses.translation: Thereupon, Rama began to stretch his excellent bow, which was endowed with great force and sonorous, as though he was breaking the earth asunder.

glosses.meaning: which was endowed with a great force

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य च बाणौघै रामविस्फारितेन च |
शब्देन राक्षसास्तेन पेतुश्च शतशस्तदा
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya ca bāṇaughai rāmavisphāritena ca |
śabdena rākṣasāstena petuśca śataśastadā
verses.translation: Then, due to that buzzing sound produced by the streams of Ravana's arrows as also by the twang of Rama's bow, those demons fell down in their hundreds.

glosses.meaning: produced by the streams of arrows of Ravana
and due to the stretching activity of Rama's bow

verses.devanagari:
तयोः शरपथं प्राप्य रावणो राजपुत्रयोः |
स बभूव यथा राहुः समीपे शशिसूर्ययोः
verses.iast:
tayoḥ śarapathaṃ prApya rAvaṇo rAjaputrayoḥ |
sa babhUva yathA rAhuḥ samIpe śaśisUryayoḥ
verses.translation: That Ravana, coming within the range of arrow-shots of Rama and Lakshmana, resembled Rahu (the demon who is supposed to seize the sun and the moon), standing in the vicinity of the moon and the sun.

glosses.meaning: the range of the arrow-shots of Rama and Lakshmana
like Rahu (the demon who is supposed to seize the sun and the moon) samiipe = standing in the vicinity
of the moona and the sun.

verses.devanagari:
तमिच्छन्प्रथमन् योद्धुं लक्ष्मणो निशितैः शरैः |
मुमोच धनुरायम्य शरानग्निशिखोपमान्
verses.iast:
tamicchanprathaman yoddhuṃ lakṣmaṇo niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
mumoca dhanurAyamya śarAnagniśikhopamAn
verses.translation: Wishing to fight him with his sharp arrows at the earliest, Lakshmana stretching his bow, released his arrows which were like flames of fire.

glosses.meaning: which were like flames of fire.

verses.devanagari:
तान्मुक्तमात्रानाकाशे लक्ष्मणेन धनुष्मता |
बाणान्बाणैर्महातेजा रावणः प्रत्यवारयत्
verses.iast:
tAnmuktamAtrAnAkAśe lakṣmaṇena dhanuṣmatA |
bAṇAnbAṇairmahAtejA rAvaṇaḥ pratyavArayat
verses.translation: Ravana of extra ordinary energy prevented those arrows, the moment they were released by Lakshmana, with his arrows, in the sky itself.

verses.devanagari:
एकमेकेन बाणेन त्रिभिस्त्रीन्दशभिर्दश |
लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिच्छेद दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्
verses.iast:
ekamekena bAṇena tribhistrIndaśabhirdaśa |
lakṣmaṇasya praciccheda darśayanpAṇilAghavam
verses.translation: Showing the dexterity of his hand, Ravana split the arrows of Lakshmana one with one, three with three and ten with ten arrows.

verses.devanagari:
अभ्यतिक्रम्य सौमित्रिन् रावणः समितिञ्जयः |
आससाद ततो रामन् स्थितं शैलमिवाचलम्
verses.iast:
abhyatikramya saumitrin rAvaṇaḥ samitiñjayaḥ |
AsasAda tato rAman sthitaṃ śailamivAcalam
verses.translation: Overpassing Lakshmana, Ravana the victorious in battle, approached Rama, who stood like another mountain, in the battle-field.

verses.devanagari:
स सङ्ख्ये राममासाद्य क्रोधसन्रक्तलोचनः |
व्यसृजच्छरवर्णानि रावणो राघवोपरि
verses.iast:
sa sañkhye rAmamAsAdya krodhasanraktalocanaḥ |
vyasṛjaccharavarṇAni rAvaṇo rAghavopari
verses.translation: Having approached Rama, Ravana the lord of demons, having his eyes turning red-blood through anger, released streams of arrows upon him.

glosses.meaning: having red-blood eyes in samaasaadya = approaching

verses.devanagari:
शरधारास्ततो रामो रावणस्य धनुश्च्युताः |
दृष्ट्वैवापतिताः शीघ्रं भल्लाञ्जग्राह सत्वरम्
verses.iast:
śaradhArAstato rAmo rAvaṇasya dhanuścyutAḥ |
dṛṣṭvaivApatitAḥ śIghraṃ bhallAñjagrAha satvaram
verses.translation: Just on seeing streams of arrows coming forth, loosed from Ravana's bow, Rama thereupon quickly seized hold of 'Bhalla'* arrows in haste.
notes: Bhalla - A variety of arrows with a crescent - shaped head.

verses.devanagari:
ताञ्शरौघान्स्ततो भल्लैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद राघवः |
दीप्यमानान्महावेगान्क्रुद्धानाशीविषानिव
verses.iast:
tAñśaraughAnstato bhallaistIkṣṇaiściccheda rAghavaḥ |
dIpyamAnAnmahAvegAnkruddhAnAśIviṣAniva
verses.translation: Then, Rama tore off that multitude of arrows, which were blazing and looking very terrific like enraged serpents, with his sharp Bhalla - arrows.

verses.devanagari:
राघवो रावणन् तूर्णन् रावणो राघवं तथा |
अन्योन्यन् विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः शरैरभिववर्षतुः
verses.iast:
rAghavo rAvaṇan tUrṇan rAvaṇo rAghavaṃ tathA |
anyonyan vividhaistIkṣṇaiḥ śarairabhivavarṣatuḥ
verses.translation: Rama on Ravana and Ravana on Rama, quickly showered each other with streams of sharp-pointed arrows of various kinds.

verses.devanagari:
चेरतुश्च चिरन् चित्रं मण्डलन् सव्यदक्षिणम् |
बाणवेगान्समुदीक्ष्य समरेष्वपराजितौ
verses.iast:
ceratuśca ciran citraṃ maṇḍalan savyadakṣiṇam |
bAṇavegAnsamudIkṣya samareṣvaparAjitau
verses.translation: Pushing back each other with the velocity of their arrows and remaining undefeated, the two warriors described circles of different kinds each moving from left to right, for a long time.

glosses.meaning: with the velocity of their arrows

verses.devanagari:
तयोर्भूतानि वित्रेषुर्युगपत्सम्प्रयुध्यतोः |
रौद्रयोः सायकमुचोर्यमान्तकनिकाशयोः
verses.iast:
tayorbhUtAni vitreṣuryugapatsamprayudhyatoḥ |
raudrayoḥ sAyakamucoryamAntakanikAśayoḥ
verses.translation: Created beings were frightened, even as both the terrific warriors were fighting all at once, releasing their arrows at each other, thus resembling the god of retribution and the god of Death respectively.

glosses.meaning: and who resembled the god of retribution and the god of death respectively

verses.devanagari:
सन्ततन् विविधैर्बाणैर्बभूव गगनन् तदा |
घनैरिवातपापाये विद्युन्मालासमाकुलैः
verses.iast:
santatan vividhairbAṇairbabhUva gaganan tadA |
ghanairivAtapApAye vidyunmAlAsamAkulaiḥ
verses.translation: The sky at that time became dense with arrows of various kinds, even as it is covered, at the end of the monsoon, with clouds crowded with crowns of lightning.

glosses.meaning: at the end of the monsoon

verses.devanagari:
गवाक्षितमिवाकाशं बभूव शूरवृष्टिभिः |
महावेगैः सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैर्गृध्रपत्रैः सुवाजितैः
verses.iast:
gavAkṣitamivAkAśaṃ babhUva śUravṛṣṭibhiḥ |
mahAvegaiḥ sutIkṣṇAgrairgṛdhrapatraiḥ suvAjitaiḥ
verses.translation: The sky was studded as with eye-holes, by showers of arrows of high velocity, which were extremely sharp-pointed and adorned with plumes of vultures and were loosed with high speed.

glosses.meaning: and adorned with plumes of vultures

verses.devanagari:
शरान्धकारन् तौ भीमं चक्रतुः परमं तदा |
गतेअस्तन् तपने चापि महामेघाविवोत्थितौ
verses.iast:
śarAndhakAran tau bhImaṃ cakratuḥ paramaṃ tadA |
gateastan tapane cApi mahAmeghAvivotthitau
verses.translation: They initially made the sky dark with arrows. Even after the sun-set, they made it dark, like two huge clouds risen in it.

verses.devanagari:
तयोरभून्महद्युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः |
अनासाद्यमचिन्त्यन् च वृत्रवासवयोरिव
verses.iast:
tayorabhūnmahadyuddhamanyonyavadhakAñkṣiṇoḥ |
anAsAdyamacintyan ca vṛtravAsavayoriva
verses.translation: A great combat ensued between both of them, who were willing to kill each other. That battle was unimaginable and unapproachable, like the duel that took place between Vritra the demon and Indra the lord of celestials.

glosses.meaning: who were willing to kill each other
like the duel that took place between Vritra the demon and Indra the lord of celestials.

verses.devanagari:
उभौ हि परमेष्वासावुभौ शस्त्रविशारदौ |
उभौ चास्त्रविदां मुख्यावुभौ युद्धे विचेरतुः
verses.iast:
ubhau hi parameṣvAsAvubhau śastraviśAradau |
ubhau cAstravidAṃ mukhyAvubhau yuddhe viceratuḥ
verses.translation: Both the warriors were excellent archers. Both were skilled in war-fare. Both were eminently skilled in the use of missiles. Both moved unhindered in the battle-field.

glosses.meaning: skilled in the use of missiles

verses.devanagari:
उभौ हि येन व्रजतस्तेन तेन शरोर्मयः |
ऊर्मयो वायुना विद्धा जग्मुः सागरयोरिव
verses.iast:
ubhau hi yena vrajatastena tena śarormayaḥ |
Urmayo vAyunA viddhA jagmuḥ sAgarayoriva
verses.translation: In whichever course both of them went, in the same respective direction, streams of arrows went, like waves in two oceans, whipped by the wind.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सन्सक्तहस्तस्तु रावणो लोकरावणः |
नाराचमालान् रामस्य ललाटे प्रत्यमुञ्चत
verses.iast:
tataḥ sansaktahastastu rAvaṇo lokarAvaṇaḥ |
nArAcamAlAn rAmasya lalAṭe pratyamuñcata
verses.translation: Ravana, having skilful hands and a cause for the cry of the world, released a row of steel arrows on Rama's forehead.

glosses.meaning: and a cause for the cry of the world

verses.devanagari:
रौद्रचापप्रयुक्तान् तां नीलोत्पलदलप्रभाम् |
शिरसा धारयन्रामो न व्यथां प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.iast:
raudracApaprayuktAn tAṃ nIlotpaladalaprabhAm |
śirasA dhArayanrAmo na vyathAṃ pratyapadyata
verses.translation: Rama endured on his head, that row of steel arrows, having a lustre of black lotus-petals, discharged from the terrific bow. He did not get perturbed.

glosses.meaning: and having a lustre of black lotus-petals

verses.devanagari:
अथ मन्त्रानपि जपन्रौद्रमस्त्रमुदीरयन् |
शरान्भूयः समादाय रामः क्रोधसमन्वितः
मुमोच च महातेजाश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान् |
verses.iast:
atha mantrAnapi japanraudramastramudIrayan |
śarAnbhUyaḥ samAdAya rAmaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ
mumoca ca mahAtejAścApamAyamya vIryavAn |
verses.translation: Thereupon, seizing hold of more arrows, reciting sacred incantations and making use of the missile presided over by Rudra and stretching his bow, the valiant Rama of great splendour was filled with anger and released those arrows.

glosses.meaning: and discharging raudram astram = a presided over by Rudra

verses.devanagari:
ते महामेघसङ्काशे कवचे पतिताः शराः
अवध्ये राक्षसेन्द्रस्य न व्यथान् जनयन्स्तदा |
verses.iast:
te mahAmeghasañkAśe kavace patitAḥ śarAḥ
avadhye rAkṣasendrasya na vyathAn janayanstadA |
verses.translation: Fallen on the unbreakable armour of Ravana, which looked like a large cloud, those arrows could not cause any pain to him at that time.

verses.devanagari:
पुनरेवाथ तन् रामो रथस्थं राक्षसाधिपम्
ललाटे परमास्त्रेण सर्वास्त्रकुशलोअभिनत् |
verses.iast:
punarevAtha tan rAmo rathasthaṃ rAkṣasAdhipam
lalAṭe paramAstreṇa sarvAstrakuśaloabhinat |
verses.translation: Rama, who was skilled in the use of all types of mystic missiles, forthwith pierced in the forehead, yet again by a paramount missile, that Ravana seated in his chariot.

glosses.meaning: who was skilled in the use of all types of mystic missiles

verses.devanagari:
ते भित्त्वा बाणरूपाणि पञ्चशीर्षा इवोरगाः
श्वसन्तो विविशुर्भूमिन् रावणप्रतिकूलताः |
verses.iast:
te bhittvA bAṇarUpAṇi pañcaśIrṣA ivoragAḥ
śvasanto viviśurbhUmin rAvaṇapratikUlatAḥ |
verses.translation: Having pierced the frames of arrows of Ravana, Rama's arrows penetrated like five-headed hissing serpents into the earth, when rebuffed by Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य राघवस्यास्त्रन् रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः
आसुरन् सुमहाघोरमन्यदस्त्रं समाददे |
verses.iast:
nihatya rAghavasyAstran rAvaṇaḥ krodhamUrchitaḥ
Asuran sumahAghoramanyadastraṃ samAdade |
verses.translation: Striking down Rama's missile, that Ravana, who was stupefied with anger, employed another exceedingly terrific missile presided over by demoniac forces.

glosses.meaning: missile presided over by demoniac forces.

verses.devanagari:
सिन्हव्याघ्रमुखांश्चान्यान्कङ्ककाक मुखानपि
गृध्रश्येनमुखांश्चापि सृगालवदनान्स्तथा |
ईहामृगमुहांश्चान्यान्व्यादितास्यान्भयावहान्
पञ्चास्याण्ल्लेलिहानांश्च ससर्ज निशिताञ्शरान् |
verses.iast:
sinhavyAghramukhAṃścAnyAnkañkakAka mukhAnapi
gṛdhraśyenamukhAṃścApi sṛgAlavadanAnstathA |
IhAmṛgamuhAṃścAnyAnvyAditAsyAnbhayAvahAn
pañcAsyAṇllelihAnAṃśca sasarja niśitAñśarAn |
verses.translation: He released sharp arrows, having the heads of lions and tigers, those of buzzards and crows, even of vultures and faloons, as well as those of jackals and wolves, arrows with their mouths wide open, having the heads of venomous snakes with five heads, bringing fear.

glosses.meaning: having the heads of lions and tigers
arrows with their months wide open
having the heads of venomous snakes

verses.devanagari:
शरान्खरमुखांश्चान्यान्वराहमुखसन्स्थितान्
श्वानकुक्कुटवक्त्रांश्च मकराशीविषाननान् |
एतांश्चान्यांश्च मायाभिः ससर्ज निशिताञ्शरान्
रामं प्रति महातेजाः क्रुद्धः सर्प इव श्वसन् |
verses.iast:
śarAnkharamukhAṃścAnyAnvarAhamukhasansthitAn
śvAnakukkuṭavaktrAṃśca makarAśIviṣAnanAn |
etAṃścAnyAṃśca mAyAbhiḥ sasarja niśitAñśarAn
rAmaṃ prati mahAtejAḥ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan |
verses.translation: Hissing like a serpent provoked to anger Ravana who was endowed with extraordinary energy and conjuring tricks, released towards Rama these and other arrows, having the heads of donkeys, those of boars, dogs and cocks as also of alligators and venomous snakes.

glosses.meaning: who was endowed with extraordinary energy

verses.devanagari:
आसुरेण समाविष्टः सोअस्त्रेण रघुनन्दनः
ससर्जास्त्रं महोत्साहः पावकं पावकोपमः |
verses.iast:
Asureṇa samAviṣṭaḥ soastreṇa raghunandanaḥ
sasarjAstraṃ mahotsAhaḥ pAvakaṃ pAvakopamaḥ |
verses.translation: Possessed by a missile presided over by demoniac forces, that Rama endowed with a great strength and resembling the god of fire, released a missile presided over by the god of fire.

glosses.meaning: and equal to god of fire
a missile presided over by demoniac forces
a missile presided over by the god of fire.

verses.devanagari:
अग्निदीप्तमुखान्बाणान्स्तथा सूर्यमुखानपि
चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रवक्त्रांश्च धूमकेतुमुखानपि |
ग्रहनक्षत्रवर्णांश्च महोल्का मुखसन्स्थितान्
विद्युज्जिह्वोपमांश्चान्यान्ससर्ज निशिताञ्शरान् |
verses.iast:
agnidIptamukhAnbAṇAnstathA sUryamukhAnapi
candrArdhacandravaktrAṃśca dhUmaketumukhAnapi |
grahanakṣatravarṇAṃśca maholkA mukhasansthitAn
vidyujjihvopamAṃścAnyAnsasarja niśitAñśarAn |
verses.translation: Rama employed there, various kinds of arrows, with heads bright as fire, others with heads shining like the sun, the moon, the crescent, a comet, others shining like planets, lunar mansions and a huge meteor and some arrows resembling flashes of lightning.

glosses.meaning: some with heads bright as fire
others with heads shining like the sun
and some resembling flashes of lightning.

verses.devanagari:
ते रावणशरा घोरा राघवास्त्रसमाहताः
विलयन् जग्मुराकाशे जग्मुश्चैव सहस्रशः |
verses.iast:
te rAvaṇaśarA ghorA rAghavAstrasamAhatAḥ
vilayan jagmurAkAśe jagmuścaiva sahasraśaḥ |
verses.translation: Struck by Rama's missile, the terrific arrows of Ravana got destroyed in the sky and fell down in thousands of pieces.

glosses.meaning: struck by the missile of Rama

verses.devanagari:
तदस्त्रं निहतन् दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
हृष्टा नेदुस्ततः सर्वे कपयः कामरूपिणः |
सुग्रीवाभिमुखा वीराः संपरिक्षिप्य रागवम्
verses.iast:
tadastraṃ nihatan dṛṣṭvA rAmeṇAkliṣṭakarmaṇA
hṛṣṭA nedustataḥ sarve kapayaḥ kAmarUpiṇaḥ |
sugrīvābhimukhā vīrāḥ samparikṣipya rāgavam
verses.translation: Rejoiced to see that missile struck down by Rama, who was unweary in action, all the valiant monkeys, who were capable of changing their form at will, then encompassing Rama, raised a clamour, facing Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: who were capable of changing their form at will

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तदस्त्रं विनिहत्य राघवः |
प्रसह्य तद्रावणबाहुनिःसृतम् |
मुदान्वितो दाशरथिर्महात्मा |
विनेदुरुच्चैर्मुदिताः कपीश्वरा
verses.iast:
tatastadastraṃ vinihatya rāghavaḥ |
prasahya tadrāvaṇabāhuniḥsṛtam |
mudānvito dāśarathirmahātmā |
vineduruccairmuditāḥ kapīśvarā
verses.translation: Striking down with force that missile which came forth from Ravana's arms, the great-souled Rama, then was filled with rejoice while the chiefs of monkeys, full f joy, shouted loudly.

glosses.meaning: which came forth from the hands of that Ravana
